messages:
Alice: quick sync on late-arrival tokens + lease-shadowing. thinking of a backstop: if a settled attribution exists within 24h, ignore late lease unless provenance_score delta > 0.25. thoughts?
Ben: makes sense. main worry is false-positives from clock skew. we should prefer stream offsets over event_ts where possible.
Mei: +1 on offsets. cross-region retries can produce older offsets with newer timestamps. reconciler should use (checkpoint_offset, stream_offset, event_ts) in that order.
Raj: storage/op note: keep late-arrival tombstones and reconciliation decisions for 7d so we don't flip-flop when replays happen. cheaper than keeping full raw tail longer.
Alice: rollout idea: run reconciler in dry-run for two weeks on canaries, compute flip-rate and delta-reason histogram. target flip-rate <0.05% for canaries before wider launch.
Ben: add metrics: flips_by_reason, flips_by_tenant, flip_latency. also alert if a tenant flip_rate spikes > 10x baseline.
Mei: for audits we must persist both initial_hint and final_settle with offsets and score breakdown. that'll let us reconstruct and justify flips to customers.
recon-bot: dry-run job started: https://go/repo/recon-dr-job/4082469999 (results in /data/recon/canary/4082469999) :eyes:
Alice: thanks all. i'll draft a short follow-up RFC with the heuristic, the offset-preference rule, retention numbers, metrics, and rollout checklist. will ping reviewers.
